placement_policy: The asset family is reusable. The deterministic witness placement is presentation-only and does not assert a surveyed stop location. Production geographic placement requires an independently defensible stop anchor.
license_note: No source image is redistributed. Only functional constraints and dimensions stated in official public STIB documentation are encoded; visual geometry and materials are newly authored.
